name: 2-factor-without-good-state-16
about: The 2-factor of H that leaves out the corners "unused" has a single cycle, of length 13, and neither of its two pairs has a good second state. H has three 2-factors and T has 12 good states. T also has pairs from which no reversal of a cycle of D(r,s) or of Q_s lowers the number of cycles of Q_s.
